silent-door.title: The Silent Door
silent-door.subtitle: A threshold between memory and distance
silent-door.poem:
Between stone and breath,
the silence learned my name.

ashen-field.title: Ashen Field
ashen-field.subtitle: What remains after the fire forgets itself
ashen-field.poem:
The grass does not mourn.
It only waits, and waits.

mirror-weight.title: Mirror Weight
mirror-weight.subtitle: Reflections carry more than light
mirror-weight.poem:
You looked back
and found yourself already gone.

blue-departure.title: Blue Departure
blue-departure.subtitle: A farewell painted in the hour before dawn
blue-departure.poem:
Not every leaving
has a name for itself.

the-weight-of-rooms.title: The Weight of Rooms
the-weight-of-rooms.subtitle: Spaces that remember who lived in them
the-weight-of-rooms.poem:
Empty chairs
are the loudest kind of presence.

orbit-of-grief.title: Orbit of Grief
orbit-of-grief.subtitle: Some emotions circle you for years
orbit-of-grief.poem:
It does not land.
It only keeps returning.

pale-archive.title: Pale Archive
pale-archive.subtitle: Documents of a life no one filed
pale-archive.poem:
The records say nothing
about what was loved.

threshold-song.title: Threshold Song
threshold-song.subtitle: The melody that plays between worlds
threshold-song.poem:
Somewhere between here
and forgetting, music lives.

still-water-hour.title: Still Water Hour
still-water-hour.subtitle: When the surface holds more than the depth
still-water-hour.poem:
Stillness is not silence.
It is waiting that has learned patience.
still-water-hour.medium: Oil and cold wax on board

nr-1.title: Hollow Afternoon
nr-1.subtitle: The hour that swallowed itself whole
nr-1.poem:
Light did not leave.
It simply stopped arriving.

nr-2.title: Between Two Walls
nr-2.subtitle: A space neither inside nor outside
nr-2.poem:
Some distances
are not made of steps.

nr-3.title: The Silent Door
nr-3.subtitle: A threshold between memory and distance
nr-3.poem:
Between stone and breath,
the silence learned my name.

nr-4.title: Unnamed Room
nr-4.subtitle: A place that never needed a name
nr-4.poem:
I left no mark.
The room remembers anyway.

lv-1.title: Ashen Field
lv-1.subtitle: What remains after the fire forgets itself
lv-1.poem:
The grass does not mourn.
It only waits, and waits.

lv-2.title: Worn Surface
lv-2.subtitle: Every scratch is a year
lv-2.poem:
The wall did not crack.
It simply told the truth.

lv-3.title: Salt and Stone
lv-3.subtitle: Textures pulled from the shoreline
lv-3.poem:
The sea does not explain.
It arrives, and that is enough.

th-1.title: Mirror Weight
th-1.subtitle: Reflections carry more than light
th-1.poem:
You looked back
and found yourself already gone.

th-2.title: The Other Side of Sleep
th-2.subtitle: Dreams that remember you
th-2.poem:
In the dream you were there.
In the morning you were twice gone.

th-3.title: Doubling
th-3.subtitle: When the self becomes plural
th-3.poem:
I met myself halfway.
Neither of us spoke.

th-4.title: Portrait of an Echo
th-4.subtitle: What sound looks like after it fades
th-4.poem:
I said your name once.
The room held it longer than I did.

ao-1.title: Blue Departure
ao-1.subtitle: A farewell painted in the hour before dawn
ao-1.poem:
Not every leaving
has a name for itself.

ao-2.title: One Line
ao-2.subtitle: Everything reduced to its essential gesture
ao-2.poem:
A single mark
contained the whole story.

ao-3.title: Pale Intention
ao-3.subtitle: What you meant before words
ao-3.poem:
Before I spoke
there was a color. It was this.

sc-1.title: The Weight of Rooms
sc-1.subtitle: Spaces that remember who lived in them
sc-1.poem:
Empty chairs
are the loudest kind of presence.

sc-2.title: Soft Violence
sc-2.subtitle: The tenderness that leaves marks
sc-2.poem:
You were gentle
in ways that still hurt.

sc-3.title: After the Guest Left
sc-3.subtitle: A room mid-transition
sc-3.poem:
The impression in the cushion
was all that remained.

sc-4.title: Before the Morning
sc-4.subtitle: The slow weight of almost-dawn
sc-4.poem:
The sky didn't brighten.
It just became less dark.

mf-1.title: Orbit of Grief
mf-1.subtitle: Some emotions circle you for years
mf-1.poem:
It does not land.
It only keeps returning.

mf-2.title: Hard Angle
mf-2.subtitle: What geometry looks like under pressure
mf-2.poem:
The corner held.
Everything else gave way.

mf-3.title: Collapse Study No. 4
mf-3.subtitle: Structures that fail beautifully
mf-3.poem:
It fell with precision.
As if it had planned this.

yt-1.title: Pale Archive
yt-1.subtitle: Documents of a life no one filed
yt-1.poem:
The records say nothing
about what was loved.

yt-2.title: Catalogue of Losses
yt-2.subtitle: Filed, numbered, unfound
yt-2.poem:
Everything was documented.
Nothing was understood.

yt-3.title: Reference Without Object
yt-3.subtitle: A system that outlived its contents
yt-3.poem:
The index remained.
The things it pointed to did not.

yt-4.title: Blank Entry
yt-4.subtitle: What was not recorded
yt-4.poem:
The field was left empty.
That too is an answer.

dm-1.title: Threshold Song
dm-1.subtitle: The melody that plays between worlds
dm-1.poem:
Somewhere between here
and forgetting, music lives.

dm-2.title: Frequency
dm-2.subtitle: What the body hears before the mind does
dm-2.poem:
The low note arrived
before the sound did.

dm-3.title: Resonance Study
dm-3.subtitle: A room listening to itself
dm-3.poem:
The walls held the note
long after the singing stopped.

rm-1.title: Still Water Hour
rm-1.subtitle: When the surface holds more than the depth
rm-1.poem:
Stillness is not silence.
It is waiting that has learned patience.
rm-1.medium: Oil and cold wax on board

rm-2.title: Root System
rm-2.subtitle: What grows where no one is watching
rm-2.poem:
Beneath the visible world
something quiet was always working.

rm-3.title: Season Without Name
rm-3.subtitle: Between autumn and nothing
rm-3.poem:
The year paused here.
No one thought to mark it.

rm-4.title: The Patient Earth
rm-4.subtitle: Geological time rendered intimate
rm-4.poem:
The stone does not hurry.
It has decided to become.
